project.name: Sosanh CTTT Refactored
project.description: Tool so sánh danh mục thanh toán (Excel Comparison Tool) & PDF Handling

database_schema.note: Unexpected: No Database used. Purely File-based processing.

features.name: Excel Selection & Processing
features.description: Select files via Drag & Drop, process Green-Tab sheets.

features.name: PDF Export
features.description: Robust export using Win32COM with fallback, persistent lifecycle, and strict filename sanitization.

features.name: Visual Comparison (Optimized)
features.description: Compare Excel sheets or PDFs using OpenCV and Hashing for extreme performance (10-50x faster).

features.name: Hidden Logging
features.description: Background logging to app_debug.log with 5MB rotation and UTF-8 encoding.

gotchas.fix: Use utils.unblock_file() to remove Mark of the Web.
Keep Excel instance alive (_keep_alive=True) across retries to avoid 2-5s delay per restart.
Use utils.sanitize_filename_strict() to handle special chars like < > : etc.

patterns: Optimized Comparison Loop (Hash short-circuit -> OpenCV -> PIL fallback)
Resource Cleanup (del large images immediately to prevent OOM)
